entries.title: Slay the Spire
entries.definitive_edition: Slay the Spire on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with optional Steam Workshop mod support.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the complete game, the official Watcher-era content update, PC capture/settings flexibility, and Steam Workshop support for optional community mods. Console and mobile versions have feature-parity for the official game content, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Slay the Spire on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play the current native PC build; use mods only after documenting the unmodded official game.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or paid content-expanded edition is documented. Humble's publishing division shutdown affected ongoing support for non-PC releases, so PC is the safest long-term archive route.

entries.title: Slay the Spire 2
entries.definitive_edition: No final definitive edition yet; current Early Access build on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Early Access PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Slay the Spire 2 is currently an Early Access PC-platform release, so Windows PC is the best archive route for the current playable build and stream capture. There is no final/definitive version yet, and no sourced console or mobile release is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Slay the Spire 2 on Steam for Windows PC and play the current Early Access build, noting the build/date in any archive notes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not treat the Early Access build as final; revisit after full release and any console/mobile ports.
